domain.name: Embodied / Physical-IoT
domain.description: Software with a physical or spatial footprint — hardware pairing, proximity, ambient presence, or AR overlays on the real world.

governance.name: Human Approval Queue
governance.description: The agent proposes a batch of actions; a human reviews and approves before anything executes.

latency.name: Async / Background (seconds–minutes)
latency.description: Work that runs off the interaction thread and reports back — jobs, pipelines, batch tool chains.

pitch: A embodied / physical-iot governed by human approval queue, operating at async / background (seconds–minutes) latency.
